# hpe_morpheus_budget (Resource)

Manages a Morpheus Budget resource.




<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the budget.

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description of the budget.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the budget is enabled.
- `end_date` (String) The end date of the budget.
- `interval` (String) The budget interval (year, quarter, month).
- `scope` (String) The scope of the budget.
- `start_date` (String) The start date of the budget.
- `year` (Number) The year of the budget.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of the budget.
